title: Shops & Money
description: Adds an some shops and a simple money system
body:
_This datapack is highly recommended to be played with friends!_

There is a common bug where nothing in the datapack works when you first load a world. This is because, rather than having a scoreboard value of zero, nothing is set. If you run into this problem, try gaining or losing some money.

# Money
## Gaining Money
- Killing Mobs ($1)
- Mining Ores ($1-$2)
- Killing Players ($10)
- Betting (More info below)
- Transferring money (More info below below)

## Losing Money
- Dying (-$30)
- Popping a totem (-$10)
- Buying Items (-$1 for every item)
- Betting (More info below)
- Transferring money (More info below below)

# Shops
All of the text below relates to the button found in the pause screen with the label "Shops" in bold green text.

## Item Shop and Valuable Shop
Click the button that says "Pick an item: cobblestone" to cycle through the buyable items. Move the slider to pick between 1 and 64, costing money per item. Do note that the valuable shop charges $5 per item instead of $1.

## Betting
_Detailing my personal favorite feature, betting!!_
You can adjust the slider to place a bet between $1 and $256 to get a random number between the number one and 1.5x the inserted value.

## Transferring money
Are you playing with your friends and want to jumpstart the little enjoyment they'll get out of this datapack? Look no further. Type in your friend's username and _slide_ over some money! (The joke was that you can pick how much money to transfer using a slider)
